blocks.text: Knotfork keeps a knot under tension between uneven prongs. It echoes small practical repairs made with what remained available. The bent form is part of its identity rather than evidence that the object is broken.
A crooked pale ivory tuning fork wrapped in thick purple woven cord, a copper bead caught between its prongs.
One-shot use: The purple cord unwinds into a broad loop, falls away, and releases the bead, leaving the fork bare. The game performs the final fade.
19 silver. Injury severity −1; reaching zero clears the condition. Health +9. Recovery timers become 75% of their remaining time; Potion Boost gives +1 to skills for 5 minutes.
Original PixelLab artwork and reviewed use animation, October 28, 2026. Image b4cbb7ce-eef6-4438-be72-1e8b4023ac65; animation 7fff8a81-dcc8-4b90-a266-a70210632fed. Reduced motion holds a still.
